heroBody: ChicMouse Studio is an indie team making polished mobile games — no timers, no pressure, no filler. Just satisfying play, refined down to the smallest detail.
featuredCardP1: Tap two matching worlds and watch them grow into something grander — a single star, a burning sun, a spiral of galaxies you built yourself.
featuredCardP2: Built for one thumb and spare moments: no timers, no pressure, no filler. Play for five minutes on the bus — or let an evening slip into deep space.
studioTextLeft: ChicMouse is an independent studio making games we'd happily play ourselves — original ideas, crafted from scratch, with one goal in mind: to genuinely entertain you.
studioTextRight: We'd rather ship one polished game than ten forgettable ones. No timers, no pay-to-win pressure, no lazy filler — just fun that respects your time and keeps you coming back.
pillar1Body: Every idea and mechanic gets one test that matters: is it actually fun? If it doesn't entertain you, it doesn't ship.
pillar2Body: Play for five minutes or five hours — no timers, no rush, no pressure. You decide when and how to play.
pillar3Body: Original worlds built from our own ideas, art, and code — crafted from scratch by our small team, never recycled.
contactTagline: Questions, feedback, or inquiries — we're here.

stellarFusionDescP1: Stellar Fusion is a satisfying cosmic puzzle game built around a simple idea: combine matching celestial objects to evolve them into something greater. Planets become star systems, star systems become galaxies.
stellarFusionDescP2: With an intuitive one-hand design and a tranquil atmosphere, Stellar Fusion is built to be played anywhere — whether for a quick session or a long cosmic journey. No timers, no pressure.
stellarFusionFeature1Body: Drag and drop matching objects to combine them into new celestial bodies. Each merge reveals a new tier of cosmic wonder waiting to be discovered.
stellarFusionFeature2Body: Dozens of unique celestial bodies to unlock. Every session builds toward something bigger, with meaningful milestones and rewards along the way.
stellarFusionFeature3Body: No timers, no intrusive ads. Stellar Fusion is designed to be a focused, relaxing experience — play entirely at your own pace.
cookieBannerDescription: We use Google Fonts (external CDN) to display text on this site. When you submit the contact form your name and email are sent to our inbox — they are not stored on your device.
